name: H. N. Warren
mentions: The entire stage outfit rolled in Tuesday evening, horses, coaches, station furniture and all. It is altogether likely, however, that the line will be partially or wholly stocked again for carrying the mail.

The new contractor, H. N. Warren, who has secured the mail contract, between Medora and Deadwood should be made to either sub-let it, or put on the service needed. The route has become one of importance…
